changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'OpenIdRequest') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OpenIdRequest]( [State] [varchar](5) NOT NULL, [Nonce] [varchar](5) NOT NULL, [RedirectUrl] [varchar](2000) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_OpenIdRequest] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [State] ASC ) ) END
